audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Heimerdinger Level 1 and Renekton Levels 3, 4-5, first item and 2+ items — the exact inverse of the packet and of the page's own prose, which calls 4-5 'your hardest stretch' and says 'in a straight 1v1 he never beats the buildings'. diff also read TRICKY at 7.5/10 in a 54.17% lane.
audit.why: Packet chart is [Renekton, Skill, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger]; whys[0], whys[2], whys[3], whys[5] and whys[6] already match it.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 -> Renekton, 2, 3, 5, 6 -> Heimerdinger in both layers with matched ratings; diff TRICKY -> FAV, diffRating 7.5/10 -> 4.5/10, difficulty and final-rating lines matched.

audit.why: Four spikes with the right shape: his Level 1 fury window, your 4-5 nest, your Level 6 UPGRADE!!!, your 2-item scaling as his burst falls off.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Empowered = long stun' was the entire ability description, with no cooldowns and no numbers — and the empowered W's most important property was missing.
audit.why: Ruthless Predator is 16/14/12/10/8s: 0.75s stun normally, but above 50 Fury it slashes three times, stuns for 1.5 seconds AND destroys damage shields on the target. Slice and Dice is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s and is his only way in. Cull the Meek is a 7s heal off your wave, which is what the anti-heal advice is actually for (flagged missing interaction).
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries all four numbers plus both stun durations and the shield destruction; dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[1].d and dosFull[1].d carry the same facts in the fields a player reads mid-game.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ruthless Predator's auto-attack reset was never mentioned, so the page tells you to react to the cast.
audit.why: The kit flags W as an auto-reset — the wind-up is the tell, and reacting to the cast is already too late to hold your 11s grenade for the right moment.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d now says to read the wind-up rather than the cast.

audit.why: Packet flagged 'Slice and Dices' in mid as a probable wrong ability name. It is the correct name used as a verb — false positive.

edits.before: One turret + AA wins level 1 against almost everyone. Identify how Renekton contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: One turret and no stun against a Slice and Dice into empowered W — concede the contact window and last-hit safe.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Ruthless Predator's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your peak: three charges plus the center-stun make his dive suicidal, and Slice and Dice is 16s if he spends it to reach you.

edits.before: Liandry's Torment is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Ruthless Predator's cooldown.
edits.after: Liandry's owns the architecture war — he cannot poke the nest down and cannot safely enter it.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 7.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Ruthless Predator and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 4.5/10. Favoured — the lane is decided by surviving levels 1-2 and holding the grenade for his dash-in.

edits.before: Tricky matchup — difficulty 7.5/10, Renekton carry threat 7/10.
edits.after: Favoured matchup — difficulty 4.5/10, Renekton carry threat 7/10.

edits.before: - Renekton Ruthless Predator: matchup-defining — Empowered = long stun. E-stun first. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ruthless Predator: 16s at rank 1 — 0.75s stun, or 1.5s and it destroys damage shields above 50 Fury. - Slice and Dice: 16s at rank 1, his only way in. - Cull the Meek: 7s, heals off your wave. - Your grenade: 11s.

edits.before: Keep Renekton farming inside turret range, W-poke his step-ups, and E-stun the moment he commits into the nest.
edits.after: Cull the Meek heals him every 7s off your wave — anti-heal early, and read his W wind-up, never the cast.

edits.before: Renekton wastes Ruthless Predator (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: His W is spent: 16s at rank 1, and without Fury it only stuns for 0.75s.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Above 50 Fury it stuns for 1.5s and destroys your damage shields.

notes: UNVERIFIED CLAIM LEFT IN PLACE: four fields (whys[4], spikes[2], mid, wants.you[1]) build advice on 'once he burns E to get on you he has no second dash'. Riot's kit text for Slice and Dice says only 'Renekton dashes, dealing damage to units along the way' — it does not mention a recast, and the file's needsResearch is empty by design, so I cannot confirm or deny a second cast from the data I am allowed to treat as authority. If Slice and Dice does have a second dash in patch 26.15, then the level-6 plan on this page ('the super-stun pins him and he cannot escape') is wrong in the player's favour, which is the dangerous direction. Worth one manual check before this ships — I did not edit those lines rather than guess.
